findings.message: Monospace type outside code: Geist Mono — e.g. "+2", "2", "2 marks past surface", "2"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 1 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "Self-check"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 7 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): figcaption.font-sans.text-[13px] 462px | details.mt-4.border-t 879px | p.mt-3.border-t 879px | figcaption.font-sans.text-[13px] 879px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 6 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #fafaf8, section #fafaf8, button #fafaf8).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Geist, Geist Mono, DM Sans).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 2 picture(s) on the page (2 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 116 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 44 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Only 6 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 2 of 12 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 7, 12.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
